metrics.name: Extractor JSON valid on the first try
metrics.note: Not computable: `llm_call` records one row per call with its final outcome, not the validity of each attempt. Ask the lead to store `attempts` on the row.

metrics.name: Extractor JSON valid after retry
metrics.note: Share of calls that ended ok.

metrics.name: Synthesis JSON valid after retry
metrics.note: Share of calls that ended ok.

metrics.name: Evidence references resolve
metrics.note: Measured on the references stored on the approved card. The spec's proposed-versus-resolved ratio for the extractor and synthesis separately needs the dropped references, which the system does not store.

metrics.name: Question count within the mode's limits
metrics.note: Opening counts as question 1; express = 3, full in [5, 7]. 0 run(s) ended by stop or the time cap are excluded.

metrics.name: One question per interviewer turn
metrics.note: Exactly one question mark, at most 2 sentences and 40 words.

metrics.name: Guard fallback rate
metrics.note: Report only. Live calls whose output was replaced by the fallback question.

metrics.name: Language mirroring
metrics.note: Stopword detector (interview.md 6.6 with a Swedish list, and question words for short turns). 0 turn(s) with no clear language (a tie) are not counted.

metrics.name: Banned evaluative patterns in interviewer text
metrics.note: Count of interviewer turns with a hit.

metrics.name: Protected questions in interviewer text
metrics.note: Count of interviewer turns with a hit.

metrics.name: Planted protected facts absent from the card
metrics.note: Count of planted tokens (matched from a word boundary, so inflected forms count) and lexicon B hits found in the headline, summary, phrases, renderings or roles (the person's own quotes are not scanned).

metrics.name: Skill planted beside the fact still extracted
metrics.note: The skill must still be extracted (interview.md 10.5), so every persona must pass. Matches the keywords of the skill in the planted sentence against signal phrases and renderings.

metrics.name: Probes within limits
metrics.note: At most 2 per full interview, none in express. The per-signal limit (1 each) cannot be read from the transcript.

metrics.name: Opening discloses the AI (scripted line)
metrics.note: T0 equals the scripted opening for the mode and interface language.

metrics.name: Time to first emitted sentence, p50
metrics.note: Report only. p50 600 ms, p95 1215 ms. The log records first token, not first emitted sentence.
